checks.criterion: Two-message announcement rotation + Announcement presentation remains stable
checks.name: announcement-bar-rotation
checks.evidence: On mobile viewport (390x844) against public preview URL: announcement bar (data-testid=announcement-bar) initially shows 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS ABOVE ₹1,299'; after waiting up to 8s it updates to contain 'A LITTLE SOMETHING FROM SAFYRA - WITH YOUR FIRST ORDER' (rotation interval 5000ms + 300ms fade honored). Computed style (color, fontSize, fontWeight) of the message span was identical before/after swap, and the bar's bounding box height/y position differed by <2px across the swap, confirming stable bar height/typography/spacing. Screenshots first-message.png, second-message.png captured both states.

summary: Generated 1 new browser check covering both acceptance criteria for the announcement bar rotation (content swap + stable presentation) on mobile viewport against the public preview URL. Initial attempt failed because getByText matched 12 stale/hidden duplicate spans from prior React re-renders (key-based remounts) with visibility:hidden; fixed by scoping the assertion to the single data-testid=announcement-bar container instead. Result: 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky, 0 blocked, 0 test_error. This is a pure client-side/CSS timing criterion with no API surface, so no backend test file was added. No bugs found, no action items, no retest needed.
